senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; סוּג) [that which is to be removed; cmp. בְּדִיל,] dross, base metal; refuse.
units: <cite ref="Bekhorot 51a:6">Bekh. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>שלא יביא ס׳ לעזרה</he> Ar. (ed. <he>סִיגָה</he>) in order that one may not bring base metal to the Temple (therefore stamped silver coins had to be brought along; Rashi: <he>סיגה וכסף סיגים</he> base metal or non-purified silver).—Pl. <cite ref="O00560"><he>סִיגִים</he></cite>, <he>סִגִּים</he>.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:2">Num. R. s. 14</cite> (ref. to <he>סוג לב</he>, <cite ref="Proverbs 14:14">Prov. XIV, 14</cite>) <he>אותו הלב שהוא מלא ס׳ וכ׳</he> the heart full of base things, will get sick of its own ways.
<cite ref="Proverbs 14:14">Ib.</cite> s. 13 <he>יחזקאל קורא אותם ס׳</he> Ezekiel calls them base metal (ref. to <cite ref="Ezekiel 22:18">Ez. XXII, 18</cite>).

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 119:29">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXIX, 119</cite>) <he>אכל הענבים נעשה ס׳</he> ed. Bub. (ed. <he>עושה סוגים</he>, corr. acc.) after he has eaten the grapes, it (the cluster) becomes refuse.
